item.title: Police urge winter vigilance as terror threat substantial
item.description: Counter Terrorism Policing North East and Durham Constabulary have issued a winter safety appeal as crowds gather across the region for Christmas markets, shopping and seasonal events. The post Police urge winter vigilance as terror threat substantial first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK launches Atlantic Bastion to counter Russia at sea
item.description: The project links autonomous vessels, AI enabled detection networks and existing naval and air platforms, the government stated. The post UK launches Atlantic Bastion to counter Russia at sea first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Drivers jailed after nearly 50 migrants found in lorries
item.description: Two Romanian drivers have been jailed for attempting to smuggle almost fifty people from the UK into France using vans and lorries, following a National Crime Agency operation at Dover Port in September. The post Drivers jailed after nearly 50 migrants found in lorries first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: MOD awards £13m for SATCOM fit for next Type 26 frigates
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has awarded a £12.96 million contract to STS Defence for the production and installation communications equipment on the Royal Navy’s next batch of Type 26 frigates. The post MOD awards £13m for SATCOM fit for next Type 26 frigates first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy probe finds systemic failures in Truman mishaps
item.description: A set of U.S. Navy investigations has found that four separate incidents involving USS Harry S Truman and its air wing during the carrier strike group’s 2024 to 2025 combat deployment were all preventable. The reports examined mishaps that occurred while the group was striking Houthi targets and operating under sustained missile and drone threat […] The post U.S. Navy probe finds systemic failures in Truman mishaps first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain close to losing the Atlantic, First Sea Lord warns
item.description: The First Sea Lord has warned Britain is close to losing its Atlantic edge and called for a rapid shift to hybrid, tech driven naval warfare to hold the line against Russia. The post Britain close to losing the Atlantic, First Sea Lord warns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy set to debut autonomous ships and fighter drones
item.description: The Royal Navy will shortly trial its first autonomous escort and carrier-launched fighter drones as part of a push to regain strike advantage in the North Atlantic. The post Royal Navy set to debut autonomous ships and fighter drones first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Paras endure Belize jungle for tough training
item.description: Paratroopers from 3rd Battalion The Parachute Regiment have completed a month of intensive training in the jungles of Belize, an environment the Army describes as one of the most demanding it routinely uses. The post Paras endure Belize jungle for tough training first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Babcock offer drone warships with Type 31 command ships
item.description: Babcock has set out a plan to turn the Royal Navy’s Type 31 frigates into command vessels for a fleet of large HII-built autonomous warships. The post Babcock offer drone warships with Type 31 command ships first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British maritime patrol aircraft surge to Iceland
item.description: The RAF has carried out its largest ever deployment of P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft, sending three jets from 120 Squadron to Keflavik Air Base in Iceland as part of NATO vigilance activity. The post British maritime patrol aircraft surge to Iceland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
